#283. A nuclear blast could save Earth from an asteroid, but there's a catch

📅 08 Nov 2026

A nuclear blast could save Earth from an asteroid, but there's a catch

Tanggal: 08 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261106174532.htm

Berdasarkan laporan, a nuclear explosion could potentially protect earth from an incoming asteroid by releasing powerful x-rays that heat its surface and push it onto a safer trajectory. However, new research suggests that the success of such a mission could depend heavily on which side of the asteroid receives the blast.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike the smooth, round objects often used in computer simulations, real asteroids have uneven surfaces and irregular shapes. Those differences can dramatically influence how an asteroid moves when exposed to intense radiation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a new study published in icarus found that changing the direction of an x-ray burst could produce vastly different results, even when targeting the same asteroid. 9 millimeters per second when irradiated from one direction, compared with only 0. 8 millimeters per second from another. In one simulation, the asteroid's speed changed by 3. That represents a nearly fivefold difference in deflection velocity, the change in the asteroid's forward speed caused by the burst.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we expected aim to matter," said nathan moore, a physicist at sandia national laboratories who led the research. "What surprised us was how much. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the effects on an asteroid's rotation could be even more dramatic. For another simulated asteroid, the change in how quickly it spun varied by a factor of 17 depending on the direction of the X-rays.

These findings suggest that understanding an asteroid's shape and carefully selecting where to direct a nuclear blast could be essential to protecting Earth from a future impact.

The research received funding through Sandia's Laboratory Directed Research and Development program.

A New Way to Simulate Asteroid Deflection.

To investigate how different asteroid shapes respond to nuclear blasts, Moore and his colleagues developed what they describe as the most accurate asteroid deflection model yet.

Berdasarkan laporan, earlier computer models faced a major limitation. Researchers typically had to choose between representing an asteroid's complex shape and performing highly detailed calculations of the physical forces involved. Combining both approaches demanded more computing power than was practical.

Berdasarkan laporan, the new system overcomes that obstacle, allowing scientists to study realistic asteroid shapes while maintaining the precision needed to calculate their response to an x-ray burst. The result is the most detailed simulation of asteroid deflection produced so far.

Diungkapkan bahwa "our new algorithm is over 1,600 times faster, which was critical to this breakthrough," moore said. "With the old models, computers just couldn't handle it. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, moore's interest in improving these calculations grew out of an earlier experiment using sandia's z machine. That experiment provided the first demonstration that X-rays could deflect a small piece of asteroid material.

The next challenge was determining how the same physical process might affect an entire asteroid.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i started wondering how to scale up the calculation to more accurately predict deflection of a full-scale asteroid. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, a major problem was the widespread practice of treating asteroids as spheres. Although this simplifies the mathematics, it overlooks the irregular shapes of real asteroids, which can have ridges, depressions, and uneven surfaces.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "you can make estimates that way, but asteroids come in all kinds of odd, lumpy shapes," he said. No more spheres. We would be able to model deflection for any asteroid. I think we had an aha moment when we realized we could do this. "That's when I latched onto some work one of my colleagues was doing related to outgassing of objects in space. ".

The solution involved bringing together two sophisticated simulation systems already used at Sandia for very different types of physical problems.

"The ALEGRA code is normally used to model fast, high-energy experiments, like magnetically imploding wires on the Z machine, while SPARTA, a direct simulation Monte Carlo code, is usually used to model comparatively weak, slowly evolving forces, like the drag on a satellite from the solar wind," Moore explained.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the key innovation here was figuring out how to combine the two simulation approaches. ".

Predicting What Happens After a Nuclear Blast.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the new computer model allows researchers to reconstruct an asteroid using detailed 3d images captured during spacecraft flybys. They can then simulate a nuclear X-ray burst while adjusting the explosion's strength, its distance from the asteroid, and the direction from which the radiation arrives.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the software calculates how much material would vaporize across different parts of the asteroid's surface and displays the results as a heat map. Using that information, it estimates the resulting push, changes in the asteroid's rotation, and the extent of surface damage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these calculations are important because a successful planetary defense mission would ideally change an asteroid's trajectory without breaking it into multiple dangerous fragments. Redirecting one large object could be preferable to creating several pieces that might still threaten Earth.

However, the simulations cannot yet predict every possible consequence of a nuclear blast.

Berdasarkan laporan, "right now, our computer model only considers breakup of rocks on the surface. We can't predict breakup of the entire asteroid body accurately yet," Moore said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, developing that capability will require additional research, investment, and more advanced computational tools. An intense X-ray burst can trigger numerous physical effects, some of which influence one another. Accounting for all those interactions makes it exceptionally difficult to predict exactly how an asteroid would behave during a real deflection attempt.

Choosing the Right Blast Could Save Earth.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite these remaining challenges, the findings offer valuable guidance for future planetary defense efforts. The research shows that the direction of a nuclear blast is not simply a minor detail. It can substantially change how effectively an asteroid is redirected.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "our study shows how important it is to aim carefully," moore said. Guess wrong and it could be a bad day. "Pick the right side and you win. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the new simulation tools could eventually help mission planners identify the most effective way to deflect a threatening asteroid. In principle, researchers could enter detailed information about its shape, then calculate the ideal explosive strength, distance, and direction needed to move it away from Earth.

Turning those calculations into a real mission would still be extremely difficult.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for one thing, the software requires reasonably accurate information about the asteroid's shape from every direction. If an asteroid were discovered on a collision course with Earth, there might not be enough time to gather the necessary observations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another challenge would be delivering and positioning a nuclear device at precisely the right location relative to an asteroid traveling through space. Even if scientists could identify the ideal blast configuration, executing it would require extraordinary precision.

Diungkapkan bahwa nevertheless, the improved simulations could eliminate much of the uncertainty surrounding one possible method of asteroid defense. By better understanding how nuclear X-rays interact with the complex surfaces of real asteroids, scientists are moving closer to predicting which strategies would work best.

For Moore, that progress is an encouraging step toward ensuring humanity has a better chance of preventing a catastrophic asteroid impact.

One of the most anticipated fall TV series, "Blade Runner 2099," recently dropped its final neon-tinted trailer, and now we’ve finally got a handle on the plot dynamics of this dystopian thriller set in the cyberpunk world of Ridley Scott's original.

Sebagaimana diketahui, prime video's bold and brooding 8-episode series lands nov. 25 as a tangential sequel to Denis Villeneuve's "Blade Runner 2049," unfolding some 50 years after the 2017 feature film. Now the artificial inmates are running the asylum when violent replicant uprisings flip the script, causing humanity to become second-class citizens.

Berdasarkan laporan, "in los angeles 2099, cora (hunter schafer) lived her entire life on the run, a chameleon forced to adopt numerous identities," states prime video's synopsis. The two are pulled into a widening conspiracy that poses an existential threat to a city that’s fighting to be reborn. "To secure a stable future for her brother, she assumes one final identity and is forced to partner with Olwen (Michelle Yeoh), a Blade Runner who’s confronting the end of her life. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, this engrossing final trailer reveals more of the detailed noir world and cora's plight to blend into society as a blade runner who links up with olwen, an aging replicant exterminator, for an uneasy partnership. Here, a tense scene plays out in this preview as Cora undergoes an intense police station screening while being used as a resistance pawn to help take back the city from usurping androids. But another deep mystery lies hidden in plain sight!.

"You have to see the lie that is in front of you," warns Yeoh's dying synthetic cop.

"Blade Runner 2099" sports a spirited cast that includes Dimitri Abold ("The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes") and Lewis Gribben ("Somewhere Boy”) in collaboration with Katelyn Rose Downey ("The Nun II"), Daniel Rigby ('Renegade Nell"), Johnny Harris ("A Gentleman in Moscow"), Amy Lennox ("Only Child"), Sheila Atim ("The Woman King") and Matthew Needham ("House of the Dragon”).

Sebagaimana diketahui, delivered by creator and showrunner silka louisa ("shining girls"), and executive produced by silka louisa and ridley scott’s scott free productions, "blade runner 2099" lands on prime video beginning nov. 25, 2026.

If you like playing daily word games like Wordle, then Hurdle is a great game to add to your routine.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are five rounds to the game. This can give you several clues or none, depending on the words. The first round sees you trying to guess the word, with correct, misplaced, and incorrect letters shown in each guess. If you guess the correct answer, it'll take you to the next hurdle, providing the answer to the last hurdle as your first guess. For the final hurdle, every correct answer from previous hurdles is shown, with correct and misplaced letters clearly shown.

An important note is that the number of times a letter is highlighted from previous guesses does necessarily indicate the number of times that letter appears in the final hurdle.

#287. Rosalía and Milo J Sweep the 2026 Latin Grammys: Full List of Winners

📅 13 Nov 2026

Rosalía and Milo J Sweep the 2026 Latin Grammys: Full List of Winners

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.billboard.com/lists/latin-grammys-2026-list-of-winners/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ca7riel & paco amoroso, jorge drexler, karol g and grupo frontera also won multiple awards on thursday's (nov. 12) ceremony.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with her widely acclaimed and eclectic lux, rosalía won the latin grammy for album of the year for the third time and took home, among other honors, song of the year for “la perla,” alongside yahritza y su esencia. It was an expected victory on a night that honored both major icons and fresh new voices of Latin music — such as Milo J, the Argentine newcomer who won the award for record of the year for “Niño” and took home three additional trophies, including best folk music album for La Vida Es Más Corta.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rosalía also won awards for best pop song and best alternative music album, and lux was further recognized for its recording engineering. But the honor that moved her to tears was, without a doubt, album of the year, which she received from Juanes — an artist who supported her very early in her career and whom she thanked for being there back when “there were only 100 people in a room in Madrid. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “this is the third time i’ve won this award. The truth is, I know I still have a lot to learn, and I’m certain that I likely haven’t even created my best work yet. Thank-you for your love and for shaping me into who I am today. I thank God, and I thank my loved ones — my family and my friends. If El Mal Querer was a dream, and Motomami was a bold gamble, then LUX has been a leap into the unknown,” said the Spanish superstar, referring to her winning albums of 2019 and 2022, respectively. “I believe it’s very important to speak your own truth — and for others to be able to speak theirs — and this record is mine. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, milo j, who at 19 years old earned six nominations for a project that pushed him well outside his comfort zone (urban music), also won for best urban/urban fusion performance for “gil,” featuring trueno, as well as for best recording package. “Coming from where I come from — from the trap genre — winning an award for folk music just blows my mind,” he said upon receiving the gramophone for best folk album. He was also a contender for the album of the year award. Milo spoke during the Latin Grammy Premiere — the non-televised ceremony held hours earlier, where the majority of the winners were announced — and used the moment to thank the producers and colleagues who contributed to the project. Among the winners announced during the ceremony, Karol G shone as she received the award for best urban music album for the third time — this time for Tropicoqueta.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i’m going to be completely honest — thank god i’ve been here a few times before — but making tropicoqueta meant so much to me, in ways many people can’t even imagine,” the colombian star said. I feel I’ve grown a great deal, both as a person and as an artist. It’s beautiful to watch everyone singing along to salsa, merengue, reggaeton, bachata and mariachi — because that’s who we are: all of that, and so much more. “I sat down with artists and musical masters I never dreamed I’d have the chance to collaborate or work with. So, thank-you. Most importantly, I now have an album that I’m touring with, and when I perform these songs, I can see that people feel proud to be Latino. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among the veteran honorees were jorge drexler, juanes and fonseca, while first-time winners included the young mexican artist xavi, the heiress to one of the great mexican dynasties camila fernández and brazilian superstar anitta — who secured her first latin grammy after 12 nominations, winning best portuguese language contemporary pop album for equilibrivm. The coveted best new artist award went to Colombian Aria Vega, who was Billboard’s Latin Up-And-Comer artist of the month for July and recently participated in the Women’s Panel at Billboard Latin Music Week.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i was reflecting on where i am in my life, and i thought of a college professor who once gave us an assignment to create something that described us. I put together some clippings that read ‘big dreams and good taste. ’ Being here to receive this recognition is one of those ‘premium’ dreams,” she said upon accepting her award.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ca7riel & paco amoroso, the sensational argentine duo that took home five awards during their latin grammy debut last year, won best latin electronic music performance for “beto’s horns – fred remix” with fred again. ; best pop/rock song for “Hasta Jesús Tuvo Un Mal Día” with Sting; and best long form music video for FREE SPIRITS (The Film).

Other early winners included Luis Enrique, Grupo Frontera, Camila Fernández and Bobby Pulido — the latter having recently been elected to the House of Representatives for the Democrats.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i want to tell you that i’m retiring from music, and i’m leaving with so much gratitude,” he said while accepting his trophy. “I’m so, so proud to be from Texas and to be Tejano and to represent this music. Tejano music is in very good hands; we have so much talent — young talent like [fellow nominees] Jay Pérez, Destiny Navaira, everyone who’s here. I love you all, and I’ll see you soon, because we need to represent and we need to get to work to use our voices for something else. ”.

Among the big surprises of the everning, Venezuelan newcomer Sara Schell took home the award for songwriter of the year, besting heavyweights such as Edgar Barrera — who led the list of nominees with 10 nods and went on to win his fourth producer of the year award.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i’m shaking—wow,” said the 23-year-old songwriter as she accepted her golden gramophone. And when I say ‘my family,’ I don’t just mean my mom and dad… I also mean my friends and my team. Thank you for all the support; thank you for all the love. “My name is Sara Schell; I’m from Barquisimeto, Venezuela, and this award is for my family. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa daddy yankee — the latin recording academy’s 2026 person of the year, honored a day before by his peers at a traditional gala — also won best urban song alongside bizarrap for “daddy yankee: bzrp music sessions, vol. 0/66. ”.

The evening also paid tribute to two pivotal figures in Latin music: the late salsa icon Willie Colón, whose innovative contributions helped define the New York salsa movement, and the legendary Mexican songwriter José Alfredo Jiménez, who was honored on the centenary of his birth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the 27th annual latin grammy awards ceremony, hosted by singer and actress roselyn sánchez, was broadcast live from las vegas on televisaunivision platforms. Performers included Rosalía, Karol G, Anitta, Elena Rose, Juanes, Milo J, Mon Laferte and many others.

#288. Google DeepMind Staff Tap the UK Government to Escalate Their Unionization Fight

📅 12 Nov 2026

Google DeepMind Staff Tap the UK Government to Escalate Their Unionization Fight

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/google-deepmind-staff-escalate-their-union-fight/

Google DeepMind employees in the UK have asked the government to intervene in a push to unionize the artificial intelligence lab.

On Thursday, the Communication Workers Union and Unite the Union—put forward by Google DeepMind staff as joint representatives—filed an application with the Central Arbitration Committee, a government body that resolves disputes between employers and unions.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the application, which was seen by wired, asks the cac to confirm that the unions have enough support from workers to trigger a unionization ballot. The company would be required by law to respect the results. If successful, roughly 1,000 staff working in product-focused roles at Google DeepMind would qualify for union membership.

The escalation follows a series of meetings between employees, the unions, and company representatives over voluntary unionization, which left staff with the impression that their demands weren’t being taken seriously.

Diungkapkan bahwa “they’ve been ignored. “Management has refused to come to the table. They feel like their problems have been minimized,” John Chadfield, national officer for technology at the CWU, tells WIRED. They sent it to the HR and labor relations people, who dealt with it as an administrative box-ticking exercise. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we respect the right of employees to make an informed decision about whether or not to join a union,” google deepmind spokesperson tom hewett tells wired in a statement. We remain committed to constructively participating in this process, and have maintained open and transparent communication with our employees and the unions throughout. “We have consistently listened to both those seeking to unionize and those opposed, and have acted in good faith from the outset. ”.

The push to unionize began in February 2025, when Alphabet, Google’s parent company, removed a pledge from its ethics guidelines stating that it wouldn’t use AI for purposes like weapons development.

Berdasarkan laporan, “when i joined, we really made a big deal about the principles—the red lines. We were really looking to benefit humanity and make the world a better place,” a Google DeepMind employee, who asked to remain anonymous for fear of backlash, tells WIRED. “A lot of this is about reestablishing that ethical and moral framework that we started with. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the employees pushing for unionization object in particular to agreements between the company and the us and israeli militaries. If they succeed in unionizing, they intend to demand that Google backs out of those contracts.

“We feel extremely concerned about the direction that this technology is going in,” says a second Google DeepMind employee, who asked to remain anonymous for the same reason as the first employee.

The company has previously defended its deals with government organizations.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we are proud to be part of a broad consortium of leading ai labs and technology and cloud companies providing ai services and infrastructure in support of national security,” jenn crider, a google spokeswoman, told the new york times in april. “We remain committed to the private and public sector consensus that AI should not be used for domestic mass surveillance or autonomous weaponry without appropriate human oversight. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in an email delivered to all uk staff on thursday, seen by wired, the google deepmind employees involved in the unionization push appealed to their colleagues to participate in the ballot, which they expect to take place in the coming months. “We want a union, we want collective bargaining, and we want a say in how AI is developed and deployed,” they wrote.

The group also hopes it can establish a playbook that employees at other major AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic can follow in the UK.

Diungkapkan bahwa “it’s pretty rare that there’s been an industry that exercises such dominance and power over the economy, where there’s so little opportunity for employees or regulators to have any checks and balances,” the second google deepmind employee says. “We want to show what can happen when employees collectively organize and articulate a shared vision for the way their technology should be used. ”.

Update 11/12/26 3:50pm ET: This story has been updated to add a statement from Google DeepMind.

#289. Ancient Siberian tomb reveals surprising secrets of cannabis use 2,800 years ago

📅 08 Nov 2026

Ancient Siberian tomb reveals surprising secrets of cannabis use 2,800 years ago

Tanggal: 08 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261106174528.htm

Berdasarkan laporan, a remarkable discovery in a nearly 2,800-year-old siberian tomb has provided the oldest directly dated archaeological evidence that people used cannabis for its intoxicating effects. By examining ancient cannabis seeds and chemical traces preserved in human hair, researchers have uncovered new clues about the role of the plant in prehistoric burial rituals.

Berdasarkan laporan, cannabis is among the most widely used psychoactive plants in the modern world, but tracing its use thousands of years into the past presents a major archaeological challenge. Flowers, leaves, and resins tend to decompose over time, leaving little physical evidence behind. Ancient communities also relied on cannabis for practical purposes, including producing fiber and oil, making it difficult to distinguish these uses from medicinal or recreational consumption.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, an international team led by dr. Gino Caspari, affiliated with the Institute of Archaeological Sciences at the University of Bern and the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology, investigated an elaborate tomb in the Republic of Tyva in southern Siberia. The burial site belonged to prominent members of the Scythians, a culture known for its skilled horseback riders who inhabited the vast Eurasian steppe.

Ancient Siberian Tomb Contains 1,000 Cannabis Seeds.

Berdasarkan laporan, during the investigation, researchers recovered approximately 1,000 cannabis seeds from the tomb. Combined with other dating evidence, the results indicate that the seeds were deposited in the burial site during the early eighth century B. They used radiocarbon dating to determine the age of six individual seeds. C.

"The seeds show that cannabis played an important role in the rituals surrounding the burial," says Caspari, an archaeologist and the study's lead author.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the researchers also analyzed human hair preserved in the tomb's central burial chamber. Chemical evidence in several samples pointed to cannabis consumption, providing a crucial connection between the plant remains and the people buried at the site.

"This study is particularly insightful because it combines the analysis of plant remains with molecular traces in the human body," says Caspari.

The findings were published in the journal Science.

Chemical Traces in Ancient Hair Reveal Cannabis Use.

Diungkapkan bahwa although the cannabis seeds were remarkably well preserved, their presence alone could not establish whether the plant was used for its mind-altering effects. The seeds probably came from wild cannabis plants, and researchers could not determine whether people had deliberately cultivated them for their psychoactive properties.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the strongest evidence came from the preserved human hair. Using high-resolution mass spectrometry and other analytical techniques, the team identified clear chemical signals consistent with cannabinol (CBN) in several samples.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cbn can form when tetrahydrocannabinol (thc), the primary compound responsible for cannabis intoxication, undergoes oxidation. The researchers also detected weaker signals that matched the mass of THC, further supporting the possibility that the individuals had consumed cannabis.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while these chemical findings indicate cannabis use, they cannot reveal how much was consumed or exactly how the compounds entered the body. The individuals may have inhaled cannabis smoke or consumed the plant in another way, but the available evidence cannot establish a particular method.

Diungkapkan bahwa other archaeological discoveries from later periods in central asia provide clearer evidence of cannabis inhalation. At those sites, researchers have identified cannabinoid residues on heated stones and inside vessels, pointing to the use of heat to release compounds that could be inhaled.

"The molecular traces in the hair and the cannabis seeds come from the same grave and suggest that cannabis was used for its intoxicating properties," says Caspari, who conducts research at the Institute of Archaeological Sciences at the University of Bern and the Max Planck Institute for Geoanthropology in Jena (Germany).

Cannabis, Horse Sacrifices, and Ancient Burial Rituals.

The cannabis evidence was discovered within an elaborate ceremonial burial site, suggesting that the plant may have been connected to important Scythian funerary traditions.

"In this princely tomb, the burials were accompanied by extensive horse sacrifices and, most likely, human sacrifices as well," says Gino Caspari.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, earlier research at the site identified the remains of 18 horses that had been deliberately positioned on the burial mound. Continued excavations have since uncovered evidence of several dozen more sacrificed horses, along with scattered human bones.

These discoveries reveal the extraordinary scale of the burial ceremonies and provide important context for understanding why cannabis may have been included among the materials deposited in the tomb.

Oldest Directly Dated Evidence of Cannabis Intoxication.

Taken together, the seeds and chemical traces in human hair represent the oldest directly dated archaeological evidence currently known for cannabis use associated with intoxication.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, several questions remain unanswered. The researchers cannot determine how much THC the ancient cannabis contained, whether the plants were particularly potent, or whether Scythian communities had begun deliberately selecting or cultivating cannabis varieties with higher concentrations of psychoactive compounds.

Diungkapkan bahwa to investigate these questions, the team is now studying genetic material recovered from the ancient plant remains. The unusually good preservation of the cannabis DNA could provide valuable insights into how humans domesticated the plant and how it spread across different regions over thousands of years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we have already begun sequencing some of the plant samples," says gino caspari. "DNA preservation is excellent in this case. This will help us learn more about the history of the domestication and spread of this crop soon. ".

The Vespera III is a premium smart telescope that delivers powerful features like multi-night observation and mosaic technology, rewarding avid astrophotographers who have a serious interest in capturing the night sky.

Excellent deep-sky images with rich colors.

Multi-night imaging makes ambitious targets easier.

Much more expensive than many of its rivals.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why you can trust space. com Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test and review products.

Berdasarkan laporan, i’ve spent a lot of time with smart telescopes, from relatively inexpensive seestar models to the original vaonis vespera and the vespera pro. They all promise essentially the same thing — you put a telescope outside at night, choose something interesting on your smartphone and let the technology take care of the rest. The Vaonis Vespera 3 does that exceptionally well, but after spending several nights with it, I’m convinced it’s designed for a rather different kind of buyer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at $2,490/£2,199, this is hardly an impulse purchase for the beginner who’s curious about astronomy – you could buy several perfectly capable smart telescopes for the same money. Yet I found myself increasingly impressed by what the Vespera 3 could achieve, particularly when I returned to the same object over several nights. The images were sharp, the colors were excellent and I almost never had to think about the battery.

Berdasarkan laporan, that doesn’t mean the experience was flawless. I sometimes spent longer than I’d have liked waiting for the telescope to get ready, but once it began photographing the sky, the Vespera 3 reminded me why I love smart telescopes so much.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of my favorite things about smart telescopes is watching a photograph develop as more light is collected. What begins as a fairly ordinary patch of stars gradually becomes something much more interesting. First a faint cloud of gas appears, then more structure emerges, and eventually you have an image that, only a few short years ago, would have been difficult to capture without specialist equipment.

Diungkapkan bahwa with the vespera 3, i spent several nights photographing the pleiades (m45), the famous star cluster in taurus. The Pleiades make an excellent subject for testing a telescope because the stars are bright, but the surrounding nebulosity is much harder to capture convincingly. The Singularity app used to control Vespera 3 stacks each image as it goes, but keeps them in sight as an optional time-lapse, so you can see exactly why you’re spending so much time on one object.

Diungkapkan bahwa even better, the vespera 3’s perseverens feature lets you add data to an existing observation over multiple nights (it’s actually called multi-night observation in the app). Instead of having to call it a night or start again every time the weather interrupts an imaging session, you can return to a target and continue building the image over weeks — or years. This is excellent for faint nebulas, but also for anyone who lives somewhere with unpredictable weather.

Berdasarkan laporan, the vespera 3 also has covalens, vaonis’s mosaic imaging system, which captures adjacent sections of sky to produce a larger image. That’s helpful for objects such as the Pleiades and large nebulas, which occupy a substantial area of the sky.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mosaics inevitably take longer than conventional images — if it images six sections of the night sky, it takes six times longer for the same image quality — but they also make the telescope more versatile than its native field of view (2. 5 x 1. 4 degrees) might suggest.

Sebagaimana diketahui, smart telescopes are particularly useful for people living under light-polluted skies. The Vespera 3 tackles that problem by taking repeated short exposures and combining them automatically. A conventional optical telescope can show you the moon, the planets and some brighter star clusters, but faint nebulas are largely out of reach. As the exposures accumulate, faint details become clearer, and the image becomes less noisy.

Diungkapkan bahwa i photographed the orion nebula (m42), one of the most rewarding deep-sky targets for almost any telescope. Its bright central region makes it a quick capture, but the surrounding clouds of gas give a camera plenty more to uncover. The color in M42 via the Vespera 3 was particularly striking: stars looked sharp, the background was pleasingly clean, but the colors had a richness you don’t always see from less expensive models.

Diungkapkan bahwa the vespera 3 uses a 50mm refractor telescope and an 8. Vaonis has also introduced internal baffling to reduce unwanted reflections from nearby artificial lights. I wouldn’t claim that the Vespera 3 makes dark skies unnecessary. 3-megapixel Sony IMX585 camera sensor. For urban astronomers, every little helps. Those specifications are identical to the Vespera 2, but the Vespera 3 has a new optical system, which uses four lenses in three groups, including two extra-low-dispersion elements. It doesn’t — and if you do take a trip to dark skies with the Vespera 3, your images will improve — but it can produce extremely satisfying images even from a city.

Diungkapkan bahwa for anyone who wants more control over their images, the vespera 3 also saves lossless tiff files that can be exported to a pc or mac using a usb-c cable. That means you can take the images into your preferred editing software for further processing, rather than relying entirely on the results produced by the Singularity app.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there’s something wonderfully simple about looking at a map of the night sky, spotting an interesting object and tapping it to point your scope in that direction. It’s one of the reasons I enjoy using Seestar smart telescopes. I did miss that experience with the Vespera 3.

Vaonis’s Singularity app has an extensive catalog of galaxies, nebulas, star clusters and other targets, but I found myself browsing lists when I’d rather have been exploring an interactive sky chart.

Berdasarkan laporan, there is a section devoted to constellations, which initially got my hopes up. Sadly not — each constellation has a diagram showing where the catalog’s deep-sky objects are located. I thought it might allow me to photograph an entire constellation, capturing its familiar star pattern as a wide-field image. That’s useful if you already know what you’re looking for, but it isn’t the same as being able to see the sky overhead and choose a target visually.

However, the telescope can still find and photograph the objects in its catalog, and the automated tracking works well once you’ve made your choice.

Diungkapkan bahwa that smart telescopes give you instant gratification is something of a selling point — but it’s also a myth. Yes, they save an enormous amount of work compared with traditional astrophotography equipment. There’s no separate tracking mount to align, no camera to attach and no laptop required to control the imaging process. However, automation doesn’t necessarily mean instant results.

Berdasarkan laporan, for example, every time the vespera 3 is switched on, it needs to establish its position by identifying stars overhead. Its Star Zone Search and autofocus procedure took around five minutes, with a percentage displayed in the app to show how far it had progressed. That’s not an unreasonable wait for a sophisticated astronomical instrument, but it felt a little drawn-out when I was eager to begin photographing something. If there are clouds, expect it to take much longer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once the vespera 3 had aligned itself, i could choose a target and leave the telescope to work. The optical arm moved into position, the camera began collecting exposures and an image gradually appeared on my smartphone.

Diungkapkan bahwa i was less impressed by the touch-sensitive power button. Its softly illuminated indicator didn’t always make it obvious whether the telescope was switched on. More than once, I had to check my phone’s available Wi-Fi networks to establish whether it was on or off.

Diungkapkan bahwa vaonis claims the vespera 3 can operate for up to 11 hours. I didn’t run it continuously until the battery was exhausted, but it lasted longer than every observing session I attempted. That did change how I used it, because I could concentrate on the target instead of keeping an eye on the remaining charge or wondering whether I should connect a portable battery.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the new, improved tripod also makes a difference. It’s tall, adjustable and reassuringly stable, with a useful canopy strung between its legs for holding any accessories — perhaps filters, a red torch or snacks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the vespera 3 is capable of photographing the moon and the sun, although solar photography requires a properly fitted optional solar filter. Unfortunately, that costs a further $179/£159, which is rather steep.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s also not the best choice for detailed planetary images. The 245mm focal length is ideal for framing many galaxies and nebulas, but Jupiter and Saturn remain small subjects.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another omission is an equatorial tracking mode. Some cheaper smart telescopes — such as the Seestar S50 Pro and the DwarfLab Dwarf 3 — offer EQ mode for more advanced imaging, but the Vespera 3 relies solely on its motorized alt-azimuth mount. That doesn’t stop it from producing excellent photographs, but it does mean more experienced users have one less option to experiment with.

Diungkapkan bahwa the biggest question surrounding the vespera 3 isn’t whether it works — it’s whether it’s worth the money. After all, it costs far more than the Seestar S50 Pro, which also has built-in imaging filters, whereas the Vespera’s light pollution ($229/£219), dual-band ($399/£370) and solar (£179/£159) filters are optional purchases. They do, however, make a significant difference — with the dual-band filter giving nebulas more contrast, color and detail.

Diungkapkan bahwa overall, the vespera 3 offers a slightly more polished imaging experience than the many entry-level smart telescopes on the market. I enjoyed its clean, colorful images and appreciated the ability to work on the same subject over several nights, while the excellent tripod and battery endurance make it particularly well suited to longer observing sessions.

I wouldn’t recommend it to everyone, but I can see why someone who already loves photographing the night sky might happily pay extra for the Vespera 3.

#294. Mysterious gas leaks suggest Mars may still be volcanically alive

📅 06 Nov 2026

Mysterious gas leaks suggest Mars may still be volcanically alive

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261106174525.htm

Sebagaimana diketahui, mars may not be as geologically inactive as it appears. New evidence from mysterious gas emissions near an enormous Martian volcano suggests that heat and volcanic processes could still be present deep beneath the planet's surface.

Berdasarkan laporan, researchers have identified unusual concentrations of hydrogen chloride gas above fractures in the alba mons volcanic region. The findings suggest that gases from the planet's interior may be escaping through cracks in the surface, potentially revealing volcanic activity that has remained hidden until now.

Diungkapkan bahwa an international team led by alexander trokhimovskiy believes the gas could originate from hot magma underground. If confirmed, this would indicate that Mars still has dormant volcanic systems capable of releasing gases to the surface.

Diungkapkan bahwa the european space agency's exomars trace gas orbiter (tgo) first detected hydrogen chloride in the martian atmosphere in findings reported in 2021. On Earth, hydrogen chloride is frequently released through openings connected to magma, raising the possibility that similar processes could be occurring on Mars.

"Our findings suggest that Mars has retained enough internal heat to support volcanic activity until recently, and possibly still does," says Daniel Mège, Professor at the Space Research Centre of the Polish Academy of Sciences and co-lead author of the study published in Science Advances.

Mysterious Gas Emissions Defy Mars' Seasonal Pattern.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the researchers noticed something unusual during early summer in the martian northern hemisphere. Hydrogen chloride concentrations were unexpectedly elevated in a particular region, even though the gas normally becomes scarce at that time of year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hydrogen chloride levels on mars generally follow a seasonal cycle. They typically peak during northern winter before declining to very low levels in summer. Scientists believe much of this behavior is associated with the planet's dust and water cycles.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, the observations revealed a striking exception. Elevated hydrogen chloride repeatedly appeared in early summer over volcanic fractures on the slopes of Alba Mons. The unusual timing and consistent location suggested that something beyond ordinary atmospheric chemistry might be responsible.

Mars is home to the largest volcanoes in the Solar System, but scientists still do not know whether volcanic processes remain active beneath their surfaces.

Diungkapkan bahwa images taken from orbit indicate that some martian volcanoes experienced eruptions within the past few million years. Instruments on the surface have also recorded marsquakes, demonstrating that the planet continues to experience seismic activity.

Diungkapkan bahwa together, these observations suggest that mars may retain some of its geological energy. However, scientists have never directly observed a new volcanic eruption or fresh lava flow on the planet, leaving the question of present-day volcanism unresolved.

Fresh Cracks Reveal Clues to Hidden Volcanic Heat.

To investigate the unusual gas concentrations, the research team combined atmospheric measurements with detailed observations of the Martian surface.

Berdasarkan laporan, the atmospheric chemistry suite aboard tgo uses infrared spectrometers to identify gases in the atmosphere. These instruments detected hydrogen chloride concentrated in a relatively small area shortly after the disappearance of winter frost.

Berdasarkan laporan, researchers then examined the same region using the orbiter's cassis camera. The images revealed narrow fractures that appeared relatively fresh, with some extending hundreds of meters across the surface. Unusual changes in surface color were also visible around the cracks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the trace gas orbiter was able to find the smoking gun. It was like looking for a needle in a haystack. It's truly amazing that it spotted a handful of molecules from a perhaps intermittent source, whilst moving continuously along its orbit to monitor the whole Martian atmosphere," explains Daniel.

Berdasarkan laporan, one possible explanation is that gases originating from magma deep underground travel upward through these fractures. On Earth, comparable volcanic openings are known as fumaroles.

Diungkapkan bahwa the researchers propose that extremely cold martian winters, when temperatures can fall to -120°c, allow ice to seal the fractures and temporarily prevent gases from escaping. As temperatures rise in early summer, the ice sublimates, changing directly into vapor and potentially opening pathways for underground gases to reach the atmosphere.

Diungkapkan bahwa the discoloration observed around the fractures could also be significant. It may result from minerals or other substances deposited by escaping gases, similar to the deposits commonly found around fumaroles (volcanic gas vents) on Earth.

Although the connection between the gas emissions and volcanic fractures appeared promising, the researchers needed to rule out other explanations.

"Looking at the spatial distribution of the seeping, it became instantly obvious to me that there was something volcanic behind it, but it had to be demonstrated," concedes Daniel.

The team carefully evaluated the chemical reactions that could produce hydrogen chloride in the Martian atmosphere, including processes unrelated to volcanism.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "a huge part of the work consisted of examining all the possible chemical processes going on in the martian atmosphere. We needed to be rigorous, critical and creative to explain the presence of hydrogen chloride. The data were complex, but also excellent brain food," adds Daniel.

Berdasarkan laporan, after examining the atmospheric and geological evidence together, the researchers proposed that the gas could be escaping from a dormant magma chamber beneath alba mons. Such a chamber would form part of an underground volcanic system that could continue releasing gases even without producing visible eruptions.

Hidden Volcanic Activity Could Help Mars Support Life.

Diungkapkan bahwa the implications may extend beyond understanding the planet's geological history. Volcanic gases could also provide clues about how Mars evolved and whether it ever supported environments suitable for life.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the distant past, gases released from magma, including hydrogen chloride, may have helped create a denser atmosphere and warmer conditions. Those conditions could have allowed liquid water to remain across large portions of the Martian surface.

Diungkapkan bahwa volcanic activity might also create habitable environments underground. If rising magma or lava comes into contact with groundwater, the interaction can produce warm hydrothermal systems. Such environments could provide both chemical energy and protection from the harsh conditions on the surface.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "looking for martian life in the seeping fissures of the alba mons region would make a lot of sense. If hydrothermal systems are active, they could contain the ingredients and energy needed for microorganisms to develop, and shield microorganisms from the hostile and changing environment above the surface," ponders Daniel.

Although the findings do not establish that Mars is currently erupting or that life exists beneath its surface, they offer an intriguing new reason to investigate the volcanic fractures around Alba Mons.

"These findings may prove to be TGO's greatest success yet," highlights Colin Wilson, ESA's project scientist for the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter.

A commercial satellite has spotted the International Space Station (ISS), giving us a unique view of the orbiting lab from above.

Most of the time, when we see the ISS, it is from down here on Earth or from the viewpoint of the astronauts onboard, peering out the windows at the station's limbs, solar arrays and instruments.

Berdasarkan laporan, but in this snapshot, which was posted on x on nov. 9 by the Australian company HEO, we can see the station stretched out in all its glory.

Diungkapkan bahwa heo specializes in using satellites in low earth orbit to capture images of other spacecraft, though longer-term the company aims to capture observations far out into the solar system. HEO doesn't build the satellites that take these photos; rather, the company's software tasks the spacecraft to image targets as they come into range.

This great photo of the ISS from above, for example, was taken by a satellite operated by BlackSky, a Virginia-based company that holds a non-Earth imaging agreement with HEO.

So far, HEO and its partners have captured imagery of a variety of spacecraft in orbit, including the ISS, China's Tiangong space station and the European Space Agency's ERS-2 satellite (while it was hurtling back to Earth in 2024).

While it might seem that satellites are just hovering above Earth, the space station and other spacecraft in LEO are hurtling through space at roughly 17,500 mph (28,160 kph), hundreds of miles above our planet's surface.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a snapshot of a satellite from above is therefore far from mundane. Rather, it requires incredible coordination and technical skill; satellite operators must know precisely when their target will present itself, and their equipment must be capable of getting the shot.

#299. Scientists discover a surprising link between acorns and lyme disease

📅 09 Nov 2026

Scientists discover a surprising link between acorns and lyme disease

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261106174518.htm

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tick-borne illnesses are becoming increasingly common across the united states, and lyme disease remains the most frequently reported. Antibiotics can treat Lyme disease, but without treatment, the infection may affect the joints, heart, and nervous system. The infection is caused by the bacterium Borrelia burgdorferi, which typically reaches humans through the bite of an infected blacklegged tick. Nearly 500,000 Americans are diagnosed each year. Some patients also experience symptoms that persist over time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, one of the longest-running studies of lyme disease ecology is challenging several assumptions about what makes the disease more likely to spread. For more than 35 years, scientists at the Cary Institute of Ecosystem Studies in Millbrook, New York, have tracked the complicated relationships among ticks, mice, oak trees, predators, and weather. Their research has uncovered unexpected patterns that could help predict when people face greater exposure to infected ticks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a new study published in proceedings of the national academy of sciences brings together nine of the project's most surprising discoveries. The findings show how decades of observations can reveal connections that shorter studies might miss.

"On balance, these surprises have enriched our knowledge of this system, helping us to inform management of tick-borne disease risk," said lead author Richard Ostfeld, a disease ecologist at the Cary Institute who leads the research program alongside Shannon LaDeau.

According to Ostfeld, the extensive data collected over the years have been essential for separating meaningful ecological patterns from coincidences and statistical fluctuations.

Berdasarkan laporan, "studies of this depth and length are incredibly rare," said ladeau. "This research has followed an ecological community -- including oak trees, mammals, and microorganisms -- examining how interactions like predation, parasitism, and competition shape the system over time. The evolution of understanding summarized in this paper is something you simply cannot get without such a long-term and system-focused study. ".

Deer May Play a Smaller Role in Lyme Disease Risk Than Expected.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when lyme disease first gained recognition in the united states during the 1980s, white-tailed deer were considered a likely driver of rising tick populations. Hunters frequently encountered deer carrying numerous adult ticks, suggesting that areas with more deer might also produce more ticks.

Diungkapkan bahwa the reasoning seemed straightforward. Although deer cannot pass the Lyme disease bacterium to ticks, they provide blood meals for adult female ticks. Scientists suspected that larger deer populations would allow more female ticks to reproduce, eventually increasing the number of young ticks capable of spreading the infection.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but decades of monitoring have produced a different picture. On the Cary Institute's 2,000-acre forested research property in Dutchess County, New York, researchers found no statistically significant connection between deer numbers and the abundance of nymphal ticks. Nymphs are immature ticks responsible for much of the Lyme disease transmission to humans.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we had detected a weak positive relationship between deer and subsequent nymph abundance over short subsets of the data," said ostfeld, "but the whole data set in its entirety shows no such thing. ".

Mice Are a Much Stronger Predictor of Tick Surges.

While deer populations failed to predict the abundance of nymphal ticks, mouse populations showed a much clearer relationship.

Berdasarkan laporan, years with especially large mouse populations were followed by approximately 40% more nymphal ticks the next year. White-footed mice are particularly important because they provide excellent blood meals for tick larvae and are highly effective at transmitting Borrelia burgdorferi to those feeding on them.

Berdasarkan laporan, once infected as larvae, ticks can retain the bacteria as they develop into nymphs. When these nymphs take another blood meal, they can pass the infection to humans.

The findings suggest that tracking mouse populations could provide a valuable early warning of unusually high tick numbers.

How Acorns Can Predict Tick Populations Two Years Ahead.

One of the most unexpected discoveries involves something that might seem entirely unrelated to Lyme disease: acorns.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, oak trees periodically produce exceptionally large crops of acorns in synchronized events known as acorn masting. These unusually productive years provide an abundance of food for forest rodents, allowing mouse populations to expand during the following year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that increase in mice then supports larger numbers of young ticks. As a result, the researchers found that a particularly heavy acorn crop can reliably predict an increase in nymphal ticks two years later.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the relationship reveals a remarkable sequence of events in which the reproductive cycle of forest trees helps determine future tick abundance. It also offers researchers another potential tool for anticipating periods of greater Lyme disease exposure.

Why More Mice Don't Always Mean More Infected Ticks.

Although mouse abundance helps predict how many nymphal ticks will appear, the researchers discovered that it does not consistently predict what percentage of those ticks will carry Lyme disease bacteria.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, initially, scientists expected both measures to rise together. Because mice are efficient transmitters of B. burgdorferi, an increase in mice seemed likely to produce not only more ticks but also a greater proportion of infected ticks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, early observations appeared to support that idea. However, as additional years of data accumulated, the apparent relationship gradually disappeared.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it kept me up at night," said ostfeld, "because it meant that my understanding of how the system works was incomplete or wrong. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the explanation appears to involve the other animals that share the forest with mice. Skunks, squirrels, and opossums also serve as hosts for feeding ticks, but most are much less effective at passing the Lyme disease bacterium to them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when these animals are abundant, more larval ticks may feed on hosts that are unlikely to infect them. This can reduce the percentage of nymphal ticks carrying the bacteria, even when mouse populations are high.

Diungkapkan bahwa "so the infection prevalence in the nymphs really depends on how all the larval tick meals are distributed across all the hosts," explained ostfeld. "It would have been convenient if one host predicted that for us, but that has not been the case. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this finding highlights an important distinction between the total number of ticks in an environment and the proportion carrying the pathogen. Predicting the risk of infection requires understanding the broader community of animals that ticks feed on, not simply counting mice.

Extreme Heat and Cold May Not Kill Ticks in the Wild.

Weather has also produced some unexpected results.

Berdasarkan laporan, earlier laboratory experiments suggested that exposure to intense heat or severe cold could kill blacklegged ticks. Yet observations in natural habitats revealed that ticks are surprisingly capable of surviving these conditions.

Researchers believe ticks protect themselves from temperature extremes by retreating into deeper soil layers or hiding beneath fallen leaves, where conditions are less severe than at the surface.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, the long-term data also revealed a more complicated relationship with temperature. Years that are warmer overall tend to be followed by fewer nymphal ticks than usual, despite the ability of individual ticks to withstand short periods of extreme heat.

Diungkapkan bahwa at the same time, warmer conditions generally favor mouse populations, which can lead to more ticks. These opposing effects make it difficult to predict how changing temperatures will ultimately influence Lyme disease risk.

What 35 Years of Research Mean for Lyme Disease Prevention.

Taken together, the discoveries show that Lyme disease risk depends on a network of ecological interactions that is complicated but not entirely unpredictable.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mouse abundance, for example, provides a stronger indicator of future nymphal tick numbers than deer abundance at the study site. Similarly, unusually harsh winters may not reduce tick populations as dramatically as previously expected.

By understanding these patterns, public health officials may be better equipped to anticipate periods of increased tick exposure and develop more effective prevention strategies.

Still, important questions remain, particularly about how climate change will affect ticks, the animals they feed on, and the oak trees that influence rodent populations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "you would expect that a warming climate, which makes life better for the mice, would eventually make life better for the ticks, but we have not seen that so far," said ostfeld. "We need to know what to expect from the different manifestations of climate change, which are sometimes warmer and drier, and sometimes warmer and wetter. The time of year when it's very warm also matters to ticks, oaks, and acorn production. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the research site in dutchess county has undergone significant environmental changes since monitoring began in 1991. Climate shifts, changes to the surrounding landscape, and the arrival of invasive species have all altered the conditions in which the forest's plants and animals live.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, researchers intend to continue following these changes to determine how ticks and their hosts respond over time. Their work could provide increasingly valuable insights into how future environmental changes will influence human exposure to Lyme disease and other infections carried by ticks.

#302. Synchron Pauses Trials of Its Brain Implant Due to Performance Issues

📅 12 Nov 2026

Synchron Pauses Trials of Its Brain Implant Due to Performance Issues

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/synchron-pauses-trials-of-its-brain-implant-due-to-performance-issues/

Brain implant company Synchron has paused clinical trials of its second-generation device after it failed to perform as expected in initial study participants, WIRED has learned.

The Brooklyn-based startup, a competitor to Elon Musk’s Neuralink, is also undergoing a restructuring, which includes eliminating jobs and scaling back its footprint in New York while building up a team in San Diego to support the development of an entirely new device.

Sebagaimana diketahui, synchron is one of several companies developing brain-computer interface technology meant to allow people to control digital devices by reading brain signals and translating those signals into output commands. The company has touted its technology, dubbed the Stentrode, as minimally invasive since it does not rest in the brain itself or require brain surgery.

Diungkapkan bahwa instead, the stent-like mesh tube is inserted into the jugular vein at the base of the neck, then guided with a catheter to sit on top of the brain’s motor cortex. The company’s first-generation Stentrode connected using an external wire resting on a user’s chest. Ten volunteers across the US and Australia received that device and were able to send emails, text, browse the internet, and do online shopping and banking with their thoughts. Synchron has also enabled volunteers to control an Amazon Alexa and Apple’s iPad and Vision Pro without using their hands or voice.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, synchron’s second-generation device has fewer electrodes and is fully wireless, using bluetooth to connect. The company launched a multisite trial in the US earlier this spring with sister sites in Australia and Canada to evaluate the newer Stentrode, and some participants have already had it implanted. Those sites have recently paused enrollment, however, because the device is not working as intended, according to sources familiar with the trials who asked to remain anonymous.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a statement to wired, synchron says it voluntarily paused enrollment “after identifying a performance issue involving the lead, the cable that carries signals from the stentrode to the implanted electronics. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the issue does not involve the stentrode itself and no safety issues related to the device have been identified. The pause was a company decision, not an FDA-directed action,” the statement continues.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the company says it has since brought lead design and manufacturing in-house. Instead of fixing the lead alone, Synchron says it is upgrading the whole Stentrode system and will resume trial enrollment once the hardware upgrades are complete.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we will continue to support participants with stentrode devices across their lifetime. Our commitment to their care and well-being remains unchanged,” Synchron says.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, two of the five us trial sites that wired was able to reach confirmed that recruitment is on hold at those locations. A coordinator at one site said the pause was not safety-related and was due to Synchron taking a look at the device to make sure the company is getting the readouts it is looking for.

These trials are key to Synchron advancing the Stentrode into a larger pivotal trial, which is needed for the US Food and Drug Administration to grant marketing approval.

“We still have strong confidence that it has the potential to be a first-line therapy,” CEO Tom Oxley says of the Stentrode.

Diungkapkan bahwa synchron’s website and linkedin page show around a dozen job openings in san diego, including electrical and mechanical engineers, microchip designers, and materials scientists. The San Diego team will be designing and manufacturing the upgraded lead and Stentrode, as well as a separate device that the company has not yet revealed that will go “beyond the blood vessels altogether,” according to its website. Oxley previously told WIRED that the company was planning to develop a device that reaches multiple brain regions at once, which could allow more complex and natural functions beyond moving a cursor or making a mouse click.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the brain-computer interface field is expanding rapidly, with money pouring into companies pursuing both implanted devices and wearables. Synchron was estimated to have a nearly $1 billion valuation after closing a $200 million funding round last fall. It is backed by Khosla Ventures and the venture firms of Bill Gates and Jeff Bezos.

Sebagaimana diketahui, neuralink was reportedly valued as high as $42 billion in secondary market transactions as of this summer. A few weeks after Arbaugh received the device, several of the wires came out of his brain, leading to a loss of cursor control. The coin-sized device sits in the skull and has 64 tiny, flexible wires that are threaded into the brain. The company had an early problem with its implant in 2024 after it malfunctioned in its first volunteer, Noland Arbaugh. Neuralink was able to compensate for the lost threads and restore control by modifying its recording algorithm.

Diungkapkan bahwa recent advances in artificial intelligence are fueling the development of brain-computer interfaces since ai models can read brain patterns faster and more accurately than traditional algorithms. Merge Labs, a brain-computer interface company cofounded by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, came out of stealth in January with $252 million in funding. OpenAI provided some of the funding, and the two companies are collaborating on AI models.

Berdasarkan laporan, while these devices have shown incredible promise for people with severe motor disorders, they remain experimental. Synchron’s setback shows just how far the field still has to go before these systems are commercially available for patients.

#303. Stronger flu shot linked to nearly 55% lower Alzheimer's risk

📅 08 Nov 2026

Stronger flu shot linked to nearly 55% lower Alzheimer's risk

Tanggal: 08 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261105224609.htm

A higher dose of the annual flu vaccine may offer older adults an unexpected benefit: a significantly lower risk of developing Alzheimer's disease.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a large study led by researchers at uthealth houston, adults ages 65 and older who received a high-dose influenza vaccine were less likely to develop alzheimer's than those given the standard-dose version. The findings, published in the medical journal Neurology, suggest that the strength of a flu vaccine could matter for more than just protection against influenza.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the discovery grew out of an unexpected conversation between a uthealth houston physician and local public health officials. What began as a visit to discuss earlier vaccine research eventually led scientists to investigate whether different flu vaccine doses might be associated with different levels of Alzheimer's risk.

A Surprising Connection Between Flu Vaccines and Alzheimer's.

Diungkapkan bahwa alzheimer's disease is the leading cause of dementia and an increasingly serious public health concern. In 2025, more than 7 million Americans ages 65 and older were living with the disease, representing approximately 1 in 9 people in that age group. That figure is projected to more than double by 2050.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, researchers have been exploring whether common vaccines might influence the likelihood of developing alzheimer's. In a 2022 study, a team led by Paul Schulz, MD, found that flu vaccination was associated with a reduced risk of Alzheimer's among adults 65 and older.

Schulz is a professor of neurology at McGovern Medical School at UTHealth Houston and director of the Neurocognitive Disorders Center at UTHealth Houston Neurosciences.

Three years after that earlier investigation, Schulz and his colleagues published new research examining a more specific question: Could receiving a stronger flu vaccine be associated with an even greater reduction in Alzheimer's risk?.

The idea came from public health officials who had learned about the team's previous findings and invited Schulz to discuss them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the public health department had seen our vaccine research and asked if i could come down to talk to them about it," said schulz, who is the senior author of the study and the rick mccord professor in neurology and umphrey family professor in neurodegenerative diseases at mcgovern medical school. "We went through the findings, and they asked if there was a difference with different dosages; I was confused. ".

Why Older Adults Receive Stronger Flu Shots.

Berdasarkan laporan, as people grow older, their immune systems gradually become less effective at recognizing and fighting infections. This age-related decline can make influenza particularly dangerous for seniors.

Diungkapkan bahwa to help address that vulnerability, the centers for disease control and prevention (cdc) recommends high-dose influenza vaccines as a preferred option for adults ages 65 and older. These vaccines contain four times as much influenza antigen as standard-dose shots. Antigens are the components of a vaccine that stimulate the immune system to recognize and defend against a virus.

The higher dose is designed to produce a stronger immune response in older adults, whose immune systems may respond less effectively to conventional vaccines.

Schulz had not previously realized that this stronger formulation was available.

"I was stunned that, as a physician, I didn't know a higher dose was offered," Schulz said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, annual flu vaccination is recommended broadly, but preventing influenza is especially important for people with alzheimer's disease. Flu infections and their complications can pose serious health risks for individuals already coping with cognitive impairment.

Diungkapkan bahwa before 2022, the cdc did not express a preference for one type of injectable influenza vaccine over another for people ages 65 and older. Instead, the guidance emphasized receiving a flu shot every year, regardless of the specific formulation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, previous research from uthealth houston had already linked inactivated influenza vaccines, which use viruses that cannot cause influenza infection, to a 40% lower risk of developing alzheimer's disease. However, researchers had not yet determined whether a higher vaccine dose might be associated with additional benefits.

Diungkapkan bahwa another practical issue made the question particularly relevant. As the population of older Americans continues to grow, demand for high-dose flu vaccines sometimes exceeds the available supply. Consequently, some seniors receive standard-dose vaccines instead.

This variation gave researchers an opportunity to compare Alzheimer's outcomes among older adults who had received different formulations.

Berdasarkan laporan, "so we started looking, and sure enough, we were able to put together thousands and thousands of people over the age of 65 who got the high- or low-dose vaccine. They're more at risk for Alzheimer's than anybody else, of course, because it's age-related and we could look at high-dose versus low-dose and see if there was a difference," Schulz said.

Nearly 200,000 Adults Reveal a Significant Difference.

To investigate the potential connection, the research team analyzed data from nearly 200,000 men and women ages 65 and older.

The results showed that people who received high-dose influenza vaccines had a significantly lower risk of developing Alzheimer's disease than those who received the standard-dose formulation.

The researchers reported that standard-dose influenza vaccination was associated with a 40% reduction in Alzheimer's risk, while high-dose vaccination was linked to a reduction of nearly 55%.

The association was particularly pronounced among women, who appeared to experience a greater reduction in Alzheimer's risk with the stronger vaccine.

Diungkapkan bahwa these findings add to growing evidence of a possible relationship between influenza vaccination and brain health. They also raise important questions about whether the immune response triggered by vaccination might influence biological processes involved in Alzheimer's disease.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, the findings demonstrate an association rather than establishing cause and effect. Additional research is needed to determine whether high-dose flu vaccination directly reduces the likelihood of developing Alzheimer's and to understand the mechanisms that might explain the connection.

What the Findings Could Mean for Alzheimer's Prevention.

With Alzheimer's affecting millions of Americans and the number of cases expected to rise sharply in the coming decades, researchers are searching for practical ways to reduce risk.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the possibility that an existing vaccine could have benefits extending beyond influenza prevention is particularly intriguing. Unlike an entirely new treatment, flu vaccination is already widely used, and higher-dose formulations are specifically designed for older adults.

The new findings suggest that vaccine dosage could be an important consideration in future studies exploring the relationship between the immune system and Alzheimer's disease.

For now, the research provides another reason to investigate the potential benefits of influenza vaccination while emphasizing the need for further studies before drawing conclusions about Alzheimer's prevention.

Avram Samuel Bukhbinder, MD, a graduate of McGovern Medical School who is currently a clinical fellow in neurology at Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard University, served as a corresponding author of the study.

Schulz is also a faculty member of The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center UTHealth Houston Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences.

Other contributors from McGovern Medical School included Elizabeth He, visiting scholar in the Department of Neurology; Kristofer Harris, MPH, research coordinator in the Department of Neurology; Mya Rodriguez, graduate research assistant in the Department of Neurology; Kamal Phelps, MD, an alumnus of the Department of Neurology; Jenna Thomas; Gabriela Cruz, MD, resident in the Department of Neurology; and Lauren Jhin.

Diungkapkan bahwa researchers from the mcwilliams school of biomedical informatics at uthealth houston also participated. They included Xiaoqian Jiang, PhD, associate vice president for medical AI, chair of the Department of Health Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, and Christopher Sarofim Family Professor in Biomedical Informatics and Bioengineering; Yejin Kim, PhD, assistant professor in the Department of Health Data Science and Artificial Intelligence; Luyao Chen, researcher; and Yaobin Ling, PhD, postdoctoral research fellow.

But follow the moon's shadow west and another ancient civilization comes into view. Before reaching Egypt, totality will sweep across the Mediterranean and North Africa, passing over an extraordinary collection of Roman cities, fortresses, theaters, temples and triumphal arches. Many lie within what became Rome's North African provinces, a region that produced some of the empire's wealthiest and most impressive cities.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from beachside baelo claudia in spain and military tamuda in morocco to timgad and djémila in algeria and the jaw-dropping el jem amphitheater in tunisia, roman ruins will experience between two and more than five minutes of darkness — creating extraordinary possibilities for eclipse chasers and photographers. Diungkapkan bahwa start of totality and duration: 10:44 a. m. CEST; 4 minutes, 31 seconds.

For photographers, the possibilities are exceptional — columns and temples may provide an ancient foreground, while wider compositions could incorporate the beach and dunes. Founded in the second century B. C. On particularly clear days, Morocco is visible across the Strait of Gibraltar — potentially putting Roman ruins, two continents and a total solar eclipse into one extraordinary scene.

Berdasarkan laporan, start of totality and duration: 10:48 a. m. CEST; 1 minute, 57 seconds.
